name: Do I need an architect to design my detached ADU?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect to design my detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not always legally mandatory for smaller ADUs, hiring an architect or experienced design professional is highly recommended for a detached ADU project. An architect can optimize space, ensure structural integrity, navigate complex zoning codes, and create a design that complements your existing property. They also play a crucial role in developing detailed plans required for permitting. Our integrated approach includes design services to streamline this process.
acceptedAnswer.description: While not always mandatory, hiring an architect is highly recommended for detached ADUs to ensure optimal design, structural integrity, and code compliance.
